sampleText: Every day, people open their banking app. They pay. They transfer. They leave.

lines.text: Every day, people open their banking app. [short pause] They pay. They transfer. They leave.
We had built more than [X] products and services. [pause] But for many of our customers, the app was just two of them: payments and transfers.
The usual fix? More advertising. [sighs] But people have learned to swipe it away.
[thoughtful] So how do you introduce a bank... to people who aren't looking?
People don't look for products. [pause] They look for what they love. [confident] So we found their passion... and made it a game.
The biggest passion on Earth was about to kick off.
[warmly] For ninety minutes, a whole country agrees on one thing. [pause] Strangers hug. Grown men cry. [pause] Nobody has to be told to watch.
So we put the World Cup... inside the bank.
Predict every score. Get it exactly right? [X] goals.
Then, the twist. Selected bank products became a way to score, every single day... so to climb the table, you had to discover the bank.
Climb the table. Win real prizes.
It paid off. [X] players...
...made [X] predictions.
They opened the app [X] percent more every day... because they wanted to.
They found the rest of the bank, too.
Profit from players: [X] manat.
Then... the final whistle.
But the players wanted more!
[confident] So we kept going.
The ABB PLAY Master League. [X] months. [X] matches.
The World Cup ended. [pause] The lights stayed on.
